content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
Key Points: Comparison of various oral anticoagulants with warfarin for atrial fibrillation.
Considerations and recommendations for managing anticoagulants in atrial fibrillation patients.
The importance of personalized treatment based on patient characteristics like the CHA2DS2-VASc score.
Review of drug interactions impacting anticoagulation therapy.
